arguments.summary: Triage is complete. The sole follow-up proposal (question-5) was approved through completed Macro task-4 because its answer materially qualifies technical relative-strength interpretation; no unresolved PROPOSED questions remain. The integrated work still has critical valuation-input gaps for NVDA and MU and critical policy-exposure gaps identified by Geopolitics, which require explicit treatment in synthesis.

claims.text: Question-5 was answered through the completed Macro task-4 rather than duplicating research. The macro evidence identifies a September 16 FOMC rate increase and an unquantified discount-rate/financial-conditions transmission channel relevant to interpreting technical signals.

gaps.description: Validated annual/forward EPS or market-derived P/E inputs for NVDA and MU remain absent, preventing a like-for-like valuation comparison against QQQ's dated sponsor aggregate P/E.
Current primary export-control status and quantified issuer-specific geographic/supply-chain exposure remain unverified, preventing a quantified geopolitical downside comparison.

assumptions: The completed Macro task directly addresses question-5; its findings are used to qualify technical interpretation, not to infer a rate-path consensus or price forecast.
QQQ sponsor valuation and holdings data retain their stated dates and holdings-staleness limitation.
arguments.counter_thesis: Company guidance, earnings execution, and technical momentum may be more important over the horizon than the unquantified macro or policy channels; current evidence cannot establish that ordering.

review_conditions.description: At synthesis, reconcile the macro regime qualification with company demand/guidance and technical evidence; preserve the unresolved valuation and policy-exposure limitations rather than forcing relative precision.

question_effects.reason: Completed Macro task-4 establishes a material rate/financial-conditions mechanism, so technical relative-strength observations must be interpreted as regime-sensitive rather than standalone signals.

shared_exposures.mechanism: A higher policy-rate/elevated-inflation backdrop can affect growth-equity valuation and potentially later customer capital budgets; QQQ also has dated look-through exposure to both companies.
shared_exposures.qualification: Company sensitivity and current QQQ composition are unquantified; the September 12 holdings data are stale.
